2607.01115.title: Towards Developing a Multimodal Chat Assistant for University Stakeholders: RAG-based Approach
2607.01115.paper_summary: University stakeholders often face difficulties in accessing timely and reliable information, especially in developing countries, where there are very few intelligent support systems. Existing rule-based chatbots are unable to handle complex, domain-specific queries and are not well-equipped to adapt to evolving institutional policies. As a fill-in-the-gap solution, we present the multimodal university chatbot with retrieval-augmented generation. The system combines the large language model with semantic retrieval to produce context-based responses from institution-centric resources, such as the university handbook. The system accepts text and image queries through the vision-language model and applies quantized inference for rapid deployment on constrained hardware. A scalable backend built with FastAPI, adjoined with a responsive frontend developed with Next.js, ensures real-time usability. Our multimodal evaluation demonstrates that the system maintains strong satisfaction scores across both text and image queries, despite increased response time for visual inputs. Furthermore, quantitative evaluation shows that hallucination is reduced from 31.7% to 6.6% in our proposed RAG-based system, confirming the effectiveness of retrieval grounding.
2607.01115.paper_summary_zh: 大學利益相關者常常面臨獲取及時且可靠資訊的困難，尤其是在發展中國家，智能支援系統非常稀少。現有的基於規則的聊天機器人無法處理複雜的領域特定查詢，且不具備適應不斷變化的機構政策的能力。作為填補空白的解決方案，我們提出了具有檢索增強生成的多模態大學聊天機器人。該系統將大型語言模型與語義檢索相結合，從以機構為中心的資源（如大學手冊）中生成基於上下文的回應。該系統通過視覺-語言模型接受文本和圖像查詢，並應用量化推理以便在受限硬件上快速部署。使用FastAPI構建的可擴展後端，配合使用Next.js開發的響應式前端，確保了實時可用性。我們的多模態評估顯示，該系統在文本和圖像查詢中保持了較高的滿意度評分，儘管視覺輸入的回應時間有所增加。此外，定量評估顯示，在我們提出的基於RAG的系統中，幻覺率從31.7%降至6.6%，確認了檢索基礎的有效性。
